channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Man sentenced to 102 years to life in prison for molesting five nieces
item.description: Joaquin Ruiz, 45, was found guilty in August of 18 counts related to sex acts upon children, as well as possession of child sex abuse material.

item.title: First Hantavirus case of 2026 found in mouse near Los Penasquitos Ranch House
item.description: SD County Environmental Health and Quality officials said a Western harvest mouse found near Los Penasquitos Ranch House tested positive for hantavirus.

item.title: Opinion: Newsom’s presidential ambition complicates his final California budget
item.description: As Gavin Newsom moves closer to declaring his presidential candidacy, everything he does in his last year as governor is seen through that political prism.

item.title: Morena street closures expected to re-open Tuesday
item.description: Street closures caused by a sinkhole in the Morena neighborhood were expected to remain in place until Tuesday, according to San Diego officials.

item.title: Suspected Santee bank robber nabbed at Mexico border
item.description: A man suspected of robbing a Santee bank this week was behind bars Friday following his arrest at the San Ysidro border entry.

item.title: Jackpot fever builds as Mega Millions climbs to $250 million
item.description: The Mega Millions jackpot is on the rise again after no ticket matched all six numbers in the latest drawing, pushing the estimated top prize for Tuesday night to $250 million.

item.title: Carlsbad homeowner takes Coastal Commission to court over $2.4 million fine
item.description: The Coastal Commission accused the man of blocking access to the beach, removing shorebird habitat and illegally installing the pickleball court.

item.title: San Diego fighter makes history, winning first California boxing title in decades
item.description: Whether it was the enthusiasm of the fans, a score to settle, or history at stake, Flores and Chavez delivered in a contest won by Chavez by decision.

item.title: New health care clinic in National City offers centralized services
item.description: San Ysidro Health recently celebrated the opening of its Macias Family Health Center, a two-story, 44,000-square-foot clinic in National City.

item.title: San Diego honors MLK with parade, fest and more, while state offers holiday freebie
item.description: Events Sunday include the MLK parade and a block party while on Monday access to state parks and beaches will be free for the holiday.
